استأهلن (form X)
# اِسْتَأْهَلْنَ (istaʔhalna) /is.taʔ.hal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهِلْنَ (istaʔhilna) /is.taʔ.hil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
